name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: O'Hare Precision's paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive. The most notable movement is a 75% drop in GBP actions week-over-week, which likely reflects reduced organic search visibility or seasonal demand softening, compounding the lack of paid traffic support.

performance.verdict: Paid is confirmed dark; organic erosion now the only live signal.

findings.text: All paid channels show $0 spend and 0 leads across the entire 45-day series — no Meta, no Google Ads activity at all.
3 overdue CRM blockers (342 stub reconcile, Sales-i parser, dedup workbook execution) unresolved since Jul–Aug 31; pipeline integrity at risk.
2 additional SOW blockers overdue Aug 31: Web/SEO root cause unfiled and Outreach contact pull (AGS + Forte) not delivered.
GBP actions fell 75% week-over-week to near-zero last 3 days (Sep 7–9: 0, 0, 0) vs prior 3 days (Sep 4–6: 0, 1, 0) — broader collapse from Aug peak of 21/day.
Search clicks dropped 26.92% week-over-week; last 3 days avg 8.7 clicks vs prior 3-day avg of 13.3 — sustained softening, not a single-day blip.

suggestions.text: Escalate 342 stub reconcile and dedup workbook execution — both are confirmed blockers with no progress since Aug 31.
suggestions.monday_update: The 342 stub reconcile and 447-group dedup workbook execution are confirmed overdue since Aug 31 and are blocking the Sales-i sync entirely. Success check: rollback files posted to Monday board and at least one audited merge batch completed by 2026-09-17. Ahmed and Dev 2 to confirm batch status by end of week.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and search clicks for 3 more days; if both remain at or near zero, escalate organic visibility as a standalone issue.

Re-check on 2026-09-13: if GBP actions remain at 0 and sc_clicks stay below 10/day, flag for SEO investigation within the existing retainer scope.
